systems.system: accès gratuit à Internet par Starlink
systems.owner: the state, under the New Deal Technologique; Starlink holds a five-year renewable operating authorisation
systems.tiers: about one million people to get free access, with priority to schools, universities, public structures and the most vulnerable zones, notably Casamance; the minister tells deputies that nearly seven million Senegalese lack internet and more than a thousand localities are unserved (2026)

note: The minister's account to deputies of the Starlink authorisation; it names schools, universities and public structures as priorities and no local government office. The town hall on the page is in an unrelated headline.
